title: Bananas are Slightly Radioactive
hook: Your bananas are secretly giving you a tiny dose of radiation.
script: Bananas contain potassium-40, a naturally radioactive isotope. A single banana gives a dose of about 0.1 microsieverts. You are more radioactive than the banana. Your own body fires roughly 5,000 potassium-40 decays every single second. And your kidneys flush the extra potassium so the dose never adds up. This means you've been exposed to more radiation from your own body than from eating bananas.
